title: pi-bash-sandbox Configuration
description: Configuration for pi-bash-sandbox - secure bash command execution with bubblewrap sandboxing

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for this configuration file

enabled.description: Master switch for bubblewrap sandboxing. When false, the extension behaves as if bubblewrap were unavailable: the "Yes (sandbox)
allow:sandbox" permissions run unsandboxed (like "allow"). Permission rules and prompts still apply (default: true)

mounts.description: Additional filesystem paths to bind into the sandbox (additive to default mounts)

additionalProperties.description: Access mode for the mount point

env.description: Custom environment variables to set in the sandbox (does not inherit from parent process)

inheritEnv.description: Filter for which existing environment variables to pass from the parent process

additionalProperties.description: Whether to allow or deny inheritance of this variable

homeMounts.description: Controls which files from the home directory are mounted into the sandbox

oneOf.description: true for default mounts (.bashrc, .bash_profile, .local, .config), false to disable all
Custom array of home paths to mount (relative to ~)

gitWorktreeSupport.description: Auto-detect and mount git worktree dependencies when the working directory is a worktree (default: true)

permissions.description: Command permission patterns (evaluated on last-match basis)

audit.description: Configuration for the audit command's model analysis

heuristics.description: Heuristics that can grant permissions without an explicit permission pattern match

cwdConfinement.description: Allow known safe commands whose file accesses all stay within the working directory

permission.description: Permission granted when the heuristic applies

commands.description: Restrict the heuristic to these known commands (default: all known commands)

denyPaths.description: Additional sensitive path segment patterns (glob, e.g. '*.secret') that make the heuristic ineligible. The built-in list (.env, *.pem, id_rsa*, .ssh, .git, ...) always applies.

blockDotfiles.description: Treat any dotfile/dotdir path segment as sensitive (paranoid mode)

resolveSymlinks.description: Verify paths stay within the working directory after symlink resolution (via realpath)
